senses.definition: (uncountable) The state or emotion of being sad.

quotes.text:
But sorrow that is couch'd in seeming gladness
Is like that mirth fate turns to sudden sadness.

quotes.text: I mean not then under the name of Sadneſs to defend effeminate Bewailings and Lamentations; let them that ſubject themſelves to this weakeſt Impatience, be alſo ſubject to the Lycian Law, that bound theſe kind of Lamenters to be array'd like Women: […]
